design_philosophy: High-visibility command-center aesthetic. Replaces soft shadows with 1px solid strokes and high-saturation accent blocks. Function-first, no clutter.

lead_card.structure: Flat #141414 background, 1px #262626 border, 8px radius. No shadows.
lead_card.header: Left: Subreddit tag (overline). Right: AI Score Badge (Mono font, color-coded based on 0-100 score).
lead_card.body: Lead Title (H4, Sora, White). AI Summary (Body, Geist, text-secondary).
lead_card.footer: Intent Pill (High/Med/Low) + Timestamp. Full card is pressable with subtle opacity reduction on active.

intent_pills.high: Text: #10B981, BG: #10B981 at 15% opacity, Border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.3)
intent_pills.medium: Text: #F59E0B, BG: #F59E0B at 15% opacity, Border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.3)

score_badge.style: Geist Mono. Numeric score + '/100'. Use pure text colors (Success/Warning) over #1A1A1A background with 4px radius.

bottom_navigation.style: Solid #0A0A0A background with 1px top border (#262626). Active icon gets primary color (#FF5C00). Inactive gets text-tertiary (#71717A).

crm_kanban_tabs.style: Horizontal scrollable list of segmented buttons (New, Saved, Contacted, Replied, Closed). Active state has a bottom border or filled surface background.

buttons.primary: Solid background #FF5C00, text #FFFFFF, font-semibold, rounded-md, py-3 px-6.
buttons.secondary: Transparent background, border border-[#262626], text #FFFFFF, font-medium, py-3 px-6.

inputs.style: Background #141414, border #262626, text #FFFFFF, rounded-md, px-4 py-3. Focus state: border #FF5C00.

image_urls.description: Abstract black and white flowing fabric texture - use as the background for the 'Upgrade to Premium' screen behind an overlay gradient (e.g., bg-black/80).
Dark abstract image with reflective surfaces - use as a subtle texture over the Profile header or Leaderboard top section (opacity 10-20%).

motion_and_interactions.press_states: All pressable elements (buttons, cards) MUST use React Native's Pressable with opacity reduction (e.g. 0.7) on pressIn.
motion_and_interactions.screen_transitions: Use standard React Navigation slide-from-right or modal slide-from-bottom for Lead Details.
motion_and_interactions.haptics: Trigger light haptic feedback (expo-haptics) on tab changes, lead saves, and copying AI messages.

testing_attributes.rule: Every interactive element MUST include a testID property.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the 'Tactical Minimalism' dark theme. Do NOT use soft shadows (elevation). Rely strictly on 1px borders (#262626) to define depth.
Use NativeWind or StyleSheet for styling matching the provided Tailwind-style hex colors and spacing.
Use Sora for all headings and card titles. Use Geist for body text. Use Geist Mono exclusively for AI scores and XP points. Do NOT use Inter or Roboto.
Implement the 'Upgrade to Premium' screen using the provided Unsplash abstract texture as a background image with a heavy black gradient overlay.
All buttons, inputs, tabs, and list items MUST have testID attributes in the React Native components.
Do not use generic blue/purple AI gradients. Stick to the Forge Orange (#FF5C00) as the primary accent to maintain the energetic, functional aesthetic.
